intro: Ten stories from the last day, rewritten in plain British English. Tap any word you don't know.

items.title: Lula wins fourth term in Brazil
items.text: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has won Brazil's presidential runoff and will serve a fourth term as president. With nearly all votes counted, the 80-year-old received 51.78% of valid votes, against 48.22% for Flávio Bolsonaro. Bolsonaro had led the first round on 4 October. Lula is the first candidate since 1989 to win a runoff after trailing in the first round. Voting hours were extended by two hours because of transport problems and severe weather. Lula will take office on 5 January 2027.

gloss.runoff: a second election between the two leading candidates when nobody won enough votes the first time
gloss.valid votes: votes that were filled in correctly and counted
gloss.trail: to be behind another person or team in a contest
gloss.take office: to officially begin a job in government
gloss.incumbent: the person who currently holds a political job

items.title: Vučić admits defeat in Serbian election
items.text: Serbia's long-time leader Aleksandar Vučić has admitted defeat in a snap parliamentary election. Based on a sample of votes, he said the student-led Student List would win 135 to 140 of the 250 seats, while his own list would take 105. Turnout reached 64.9% by 6pm, the highest since Yugoslavia broke up in 1992. Celebrations broke out in Belgrade, with crowds and fireworks. The movement grew from protests that began in 2024 after a railway station canopy collapsed in Novi Sad.

gloss.concede defeat: to accept publicly that you have lost
gloss.snap election: an election called earlier than planned
gloss.turnout: the number of people who vote, often as a percentage
gloss.canopy: a roof-like cover over a building entrance or platform

items.title: Burnham wants talks on free movement
items.text: Prime Minister Andy Burnham has called for an honest discussion about free movement between the UK and the EU. In an interview with The Sunday Times, he said migration has changed since Brexit, with more people now settling permanently. He admitted free movement had very significant challenges, but ruled out joining the euro or Schengen. Nigel Farage called the idea a total betrayal of Brexit Britain. Shadow Home Secretary Chris Philp said it would mean giving up control of the borders.

gloss.free movement: the right of people to live and work in other countries in a group of states, such as the EU
gloss.rule out: to say that something will not happen or is not possible
gloss.in the round: looking at all parts of a subject together
gloss.betrayal: an act of breaking trust, especially by not keeping a promise
gloss.shadow minister: an opposition politician who covers the same area as a government minister

items.title: Liverpool beat Brighton 2-0 at Anfield
items.text: Liverpool beat Brighton 2-0 at Anfield on Sunday. Florian Wirtz's shot was deflected in off Pascal Gross for an own goal in the first half. About four minutes later, Alexander Isak finished a Bradley Barcola cross for his sixth goal of the season. The result leaves Brighton third, with Liverpool one point behind them. Liverpool manager Andoni Iraola said the team needed the win at home to celebrate with supporters.

gloss.own goal: a goal scored by mistake against your own team
gloss.deflect: to change the direction of a ball after it hits something
gloss.cross: a pass kicked from the side of the pitch into the penalty area
gloss.finish: to score a goal from a chance
gloss.pitch: the field where football is played

items.title: Medvedev defends Almaty Open title
items.text: Daniil Medvedev has defended his Almaty Open title, beating Nikoloz Basilashvili 6-7, 6-1, 6-3 in the final. It was the first time he has successfully defended a tour-level title. The win was his 25th career trophy and his fourth this year, after Brisbane, Dubai and Chengdu. Only Jannik Sinner, with six, has won more titles this season. Medvedev is now fifth in the race for the ATP Finals in Turin, and plays next in Vienna.

gloss.defend a title: to win a competition again after winning it the year before
gloss.qualifier: a player who reached the main draw by winning early rounds
gloss.trophy: a cup or prize given for winning
gloss.top seed: the player ranked highest in a tournament draw
gloss.tour-level: at the main professional level of a sport's circuit

items.title: Quantum chips run five qubits accurately
items.text: Researchers at Japan's RIKEN institute have shown that several silicon qubits can work at the same time with high accuracy. The team used an array of five qubits sharing one microwave control line. With all five running together, accuracy was about 99.9%. They found a major source of errors and corrected it with a calibration method based on pairs of qubits. The study has been published in Nature Physics. Higher microwave power still reduces accuracy, so the researchers say better device design is needed.

gloss.qubit: the basic unit of information in a quantum computer
gloss.calibration: adjusting equipment so that it measures or works correctly
gloss.array: an arranged group of similar things
gloss.fidelity: how accurately an operation is carried out

items.title: Liquid treatment stops tooth decay in children
items.text: A liquid painted onto teeth can stop cavities without drilling, according to a large US trial. The study, published in JAMA Pediatrics, included 830 children under six in Michigan, New York and Iowa. A 38% silver diamine fluoride solution, applied every six months, stopped decay in more than half of the affected baby teeth. The treatment permanently darkens the treated area, which can be most noticeable on front teeth. The authors say the results support an application for US approval.

gloss.cavity: a hole in a tooth caused by decay
gloss.trial: a scientific test of a treatment on a group of people
gloss.decay: the slow damage of a tooth or other material
gloss.affected: harmed or changed by something, such as a disease

items.title: Audi plans $4bn factory in Georgia
items.text: Audi plans to invest about $4bn in its first US car factory, in Georgia, near Macon. President Trump announced the plan at a campaign rally on Saturday. The plant could make up to 200,000 vehicles a year and create about 4,500 jobs. Preparatory work starts in 2027, with series production due in the early 2030s. Audi currently imports all its US cars from Europe or Mexico, and tariffs cost it about €1bn last year. The plan still needs approval from Volkswagen committees.

gloss.tariff: a tax on goods brought into a country
gloss.campaign rally: a large public meeting held to support a politician
gloss.series production: making a product in large regular numbers
gloss.import: to bring goods into a country from abroad
gloss.midterms: US elections held halfway through a president's term

items.title: GTA VI TV ads start to air
items.text: Rockstar Games has started showing new television adverts for Grand Theft Auto VI. The 30-second spot drops the shower scenes from the launch trailer and adds slightly longer shots, while the 90-second version keeps them. The Xbox logo has been removed from the ad, which GameSpot links to Rockstar's reported deal with Sony. The game launches on 19 November on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar is also promoting it with real Burger Shot and Cluckin' Bell restaurants selling GTA-branded food.

gloss.spot: a short advert on TV or radio
gloss.launch: the day a product first goes on sale
gloss.branded: carrying the name or logo of a company or product
gloss.promotional deal: an agreement to advertise a product together

items.title: Sony's new Pulse headset arrives on GTA VI day
items.text: Sony has announced a new Pulse wireless headset for PS5, which launches on 19 November, the same day as GTA VI. Pre-orders open on 29 October in white and midnight black. It costs £89.99 and replaces the 2020 Pulse 3D. It has rotating earcups and PlayStation Link connectivity, which was previously exclusive to the Pulse Elite. A higher-end Pulse Edge is due in 2027. The PlayStation Store says GTA VI is optimised for PS5 Pro.

gloss.pre-order: to order a product before it is released
gloss.headset: headphones with a microphone, used for gaming
gloss.exclusive: available only to one group or product
gloss.optimised: adjusted to work as well as possible
gloss.due: expected to arrive at a certain time
